accommodation.metaDesc: Cheap and convenient accommodation in Everton Park. Book your room at the Everton Park Hotel today. In-room Dining, restaurants & coffee!
accommodation.text: Skip to: Home Content Footer navigation Get $10 off your first order with The Pass - Download the app Subscribe Book a table Eat & Drink Sports Bar Kids Club What’s On Functions Gaming Accommodation Contact - ACCOMMODATION Step into our recently refurbished accommodation, meticulously designed for both short-term getaways and long-term stays. Our 12 standard rooms boast a blend of comfort and convenience, ensuring a restful sleep for all guests. Enjoy entertainment with our smart TVs, stay cool with air-conditioning, and freshen up in ensuite bathrooms equipped with all essentials. For added convenience, a fridge, microwave, and hair dryer are available in every room. Indulge in the full range of services our hotel offers—savour delicious pub favourites, explore our diverse drink offerings, and engage in friendly gaming activities. To secure your reservation, enquire below or reach out to us at (07) 3051 7606. Our friendly staff are always ready to assist you! Reception is open from 10am until 9pm daily, with check-in available from 2pm. Room Service is available during kitchen operating hours. Woolworths, Snap Fitness gym, and the Northwest Private Hospital are within walking distance. *Please note, check-in age guests need to be a minimum age of 18years old.
